snippet.title: BrickOps — Play. Build. Customize. | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Play. Build. Customize.

Wishlist BrickOps on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5052230/BrickOps/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=owned_channels&utm_content=official_trailer_description

PLAY for the next point. Get into Team Deathmatch, fight your way home with the flag, or battle over a firework charge in Defuse.

BUILD your arena. Create a map block by block, or prepare your cover and take it into battle in Build & Destroy.

CUSTOMIZE your character. Mix outfits and accessories, then choose your weapons, equipment and Brick Gun. Make your look and loadout yours.
